sections.text: Summer evening receptions at Toynbee Hall﻿﻿﻿
Host your summer reception in one of East London’s most distinctive heritage venues.

Host your summer evening reception in a setting that blends historic character with professional, reliable service. Whether you’re planning a corporate gathering, networking event, or celebration, our experienced team ensures everything runs smoothly, so you can focus on your guests. From enquiry to delivery, we provide a seamless experience with flexible spaces and dedicated support, ensuring every event meets the highest standards. By choosing Toynbee Hall, you’re also supporting a venue with a meaningful purpose, where every booking contributes to charitable work in the local community.
Key details
Reception Format
Relaxed standing receptions with drinks and canapés, with the option to include a short talk or presentation.
Capacity
For a relaxed standing reception, capacity up to 100
Timings
Typically 6–9pm with some flexibility.
Pricing
From £45 per person (ex VAT) depending on format and requirements.
Summer Availability
Limited summer dates available across June and July: Early booking recommended.
Step Free Access
Fully accessible space, located on the ground floor with step-free access
Why Toynbee Hall

Toynbee Hall is a distinctive Grade II listed heritage venue, offering a unique and characterful setting for summer evening receptions. Renowned for its warm welcome and attentive hospitality, our team is committed to delivering a smooth and professional experience from start to finish. Located in Central East London, the venue benefits from excellent transport links, making it easily accessible for guests travelling from across the city. By hosting your event with us, you’re also supporting Toynbee Hall’s charitable work, helping us continue our mission within the local community.
Explore the rooms
To get a quote please email events@toynbeehall.org.uk
Take a 3D virtual tour of our venue

Discover one of London’s most inspiring historic venues, restored with contemporary technology for a seamless event experience. The Lecture Hall forms part of Toynbee Hall’s beautifully restored Victorian estate – where heritage design meets 21st-century functionality. Discover elegant wood panelling, high ceilings and adaptable staging options that give every event a professional finish.
Add-on’s
With years of hands-on event experience in hospitality, our dedicated team offers a wide range of event support add-ons to help make your event planning experience as smooth as possible.
CATERING OPTIONS
Tea and coffee, lunches, dinners, beverages, snacks, and more
AV & TECH
Microphones, lecterns, projectors, LCD screens, and more
EXCLUSIVE USE
Hire our entire venue for private functions, or multi-room hire available
EVENT PRODUCTION
Event coordination services from our specalist in-house event team
My experience at Toynbee Hall was brilliant!

We used the Lecture Hall and it was perfect for our event. We were also equipped with AV systems which were at a high spec and exactly what we needed. Ben & Whitney are a fantastic team and they were so supportive on the day of our events, nothing was too much to ask! I will be using Toynbee Hall for future events for sure as it has suitable spaces for all sorts of events such as workshops, conferences & training days.
